principles: Never assign one universal gram value to ambiguous household units such as handful, bowl, slice, scoop, glass, spoonful or piece.
Portion conversion should be food-aware and, where possible, size-aware.
Standard units such as tsp/tbsp/cup/ml may use standard volume conversions, but density-dependent foods still need food-aware gram conversion.
Packaging measures such as pack, pot, bottle and can should prefer product/package metadata if known.
Modifiers such as light, low-fat, skinless and sugar-free must be preserved for nutrition lookup.
Approximation words should lower confidence rather than be discarded.
